services.name: Business Registration
services.description: Register a new Estonian limited liability company (OÜ). Adult applicants with at least €2500 share capital are auto-approved by DMN; everyone else routes to a civil-servant review queue.

services.name: Person Registration
services.description: Register an applicant's personal details and apply for a product from the public catalogue. Adults requesting cheap items (price < 100) are auto-approved by a DMN rule; everyone else is routed to a civil-servant review queue.
